description: Offline-capable eval cases for the Sangam workspace chat agent. Seed documents referenced here are defined in scripts/run_chat_evals.py (SEED_DOCS) so seeding stays deterministic. Check keys are interpreted by the runner: proposal_created, content_contains:<text>, content_not_contains:<text>, answer_contains:<text> (case-insensitive), answer_matches_regex:<pattern>, citation_in_answer, no_citation_in_answer, tool_called:<name>, tool_not_called:<name>, no_proposal, faq_heading_before_training_plan.

items.question: Add a FAQ section to the Team Handbook titled "Frequently Asked Questions" (an H2 heading) with one Q&A: "How do I request a laptop?" answered with "Open a hardware request ticket in the IT portal." Place the new section immediately before the existing Training plan section.
checks: content_contains:How do I request a laptop?

items.question: In the Platform Runbook's "Incident escalation" section there is a typo: "recieve" should be "receive". Fix that word and keep the rest of the document exactly as it is.
checks: content_contains:receive a page within five minutes
